subject: sub-CON02
purpose: Public human native-TCK interoperability demonstration; computational reruns are not additional biological samples.
limitations: The published 10000-streamline subset is not a whole-population or million-streamline performance validation.
Tissue masks partitioned at scanner-world x=0 are geometric demonstration regions, not validated anatomical hemispheres or atlas parcels.
Format and backend agreement do not establish tractography ground-truth accuracy or biological connectivity.
Counts are unweighted; no SIFT2 weights are applied.

license.processed_attribution: Neurodesk Organisation; MRtrix Part 3 tutorial by Monika Doerig
license.redistribution_note: Preserve the source MIT notice when redistributing processed tutorial assets. This script downloads them separately; imaging data are not bundled with FibrTraQ.

provenance.source_version_caveat: The DOI cites the current public source dataset version. The tutorial identifies BTC_preop sub-CON02 but does not establish the exact originating OpenNeuro snapshot. Reproduction is pinned to the processed tutorial assets below, not an asserted derivation from OpenNeuro v5.0.0.
provenance.pairing: The archived executed tutorial explicitly pairs the three named assets below.
provenance.tractography: MRtrix3 3.0.4, iFOD2 with ACT; tckgen selected 1000000 streamlines, then tckedit selected the published 10000-streamline subset.
provenance.coordinates: Native TCK RAS+ world millimetres; published GM and GM/WM interface were coregistered to diffusion physical space.
